from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class ExactStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.strategy_a_pending_buy = False
        self.strategy_a_pending_sell = False
        self.strategy_b_pending_buy = False
        self.strategy_b_pending_sell = False

    def OnData(self, data):
        previous_spy_close = self.previous_spy_close
        previous_spy_sma = self.previous_spy_sma
        previous_aapl_close = self.previous_aapl_close

        spy_present = data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy)
        aapl_present = data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl)

        if spy_present:
            spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
            current_spy_sma = float(self.sma.Current.Value) if self.sma.IsReady else None
        else:
            spy_close = None
            current_spy_sma = None

        if aapl_present:
            aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)
            current_rsi = float(self.rsi.Current.Value) if self.rsi.IsReady else None

            if previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_close < previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        else:
            aapl_close = None
            current_rsi = None

        all_symbols_present = all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols)

        if all_symbols_present:
            if (
                previous_spy_close is not None
                and previous_spy_sma is not None
                and current_spy_sma is not None
                and self.strategy_a_lot > 0
                and not self.strategy_a_pending_sell
                and previous_spy_close <= previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > current_spy_sma
            ):
                pass

            if (
                previous_spy_close is not None
                and previous_spy_sma is not None
                and current_spy_sma is not None
                and self.strategy_a_lot > 0
                and not self.strategy_a_pending_sell
                and previous_spy_close >= previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < current_spy_sma
            ):
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_pending_sell = True

            if (
                previous_spy_close is not None
                and previous_spy_sma is not None
                and current_spy_sma is not None
                and self.strategy_a_lot == 0
                and not self.strategy_a_pending_buy
                and previous_spy_close <= previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > current_spy_sma
            ):
                quantity = int(
                    math.floor(
                        0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close
                    )
                )
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_pending_buy = True

            if (
                self.strategy_b_lot > 0
                and not self.strategy_b_pending_sell
                and current_rsi is not None
                and current_rsi > 60
            ):
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_pending_sell = True

            if (
                self.strategy_b_lot == 0
                and not self.strategy_b_pending_buy
                and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
                and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000
            ):
                quantity = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_pending_buy = True

        if spy_present:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma

        if aapl_present:
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent):
        if orderEvent.Status not in [OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled]:
            if orderEvent.Status in [
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid,
                OrderStatus.MarginCanceled,
            ]:
                if orderEvent.Symbol == self.spy:
                    self.strategy_a_pending_buy = False
                    self.strategy_a_pending_sell = False
                elif orderEvent.Symbol == self.aapl:
                    self.strategy_b_pending_buy = False
                    self.strategy_b_pending_sell = False
            return

        fill_quantity = int(orderEvent.FillQuantity)

        if orderEvent.Symbol == self.spy:
            self.strategy_a_lot += fill_quantity
            if orderEvent.Direction == OrderDirection.Buy:
                self.strategy_a_pending_buy = False
            elif orderEvent.Direction == OrderDirection.Sell:
                if self.strategy_a_lot <= 0:
                    self.strategy_a_lot = 0
                    self.strategy_a_pending_sell = False

        elif orderEvent.Symbol == self.aapl:
            self.strategy_b_lot += fill_quantity
            if orderEvent.Direction == OrderDirection.Buy:
                self.strategy_b_pending_buy = False
            elif orderEvent.Direction == OrderDirection.Sell:
                if self.strategy_b_lot <= 0:
                    self.strategy_b_lot = 0
                    self.strategy_b_pending_sell = False

class MainAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data):
        bars = data.Bars

        symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]
        if any(symbol not in bars for symbol in symbols):
            self._update_state(data)
            return

        self._update_state(data)

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or self.previous_spy_sma is None:
            return

        if not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady or self.previous_aapl_close is None:
            return

        spy_close = bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = bars[self.aapl].Close

        spy_crosses_below = (
            self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > 0
            and spy_close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

        spy_crosses_above = (
            self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            shares = int(
                (0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close
            )
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.spy_lot = shares

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                shares = int(20000 / aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.aapl_lot = shares

    def _update_state(self, data):
        bars = data.Bars

        if self.spy in bars and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = bars[self.spy].Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        if self.aapl in bars:
            close = bars[self.aapl].Close

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = close

            and spy_close < current_spy_sma
        )

        spy_crosses_above = (
            self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > current_spy_sma
        )

        aapl_sell_reason = (
            self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and current_aapl_rsi > 60
        )

        # Evaluate sells before buys.
        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot, tag="Strategy A sell")
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and aapl_sell_reason:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot, tag="Strategy B sell")
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        # Slot 1: Strategy A.
        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            target_value = 0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
            quantity = math.floor(target_value / spy_close)

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity, tag="Strategy A buy")
                self.spy_lot = quantity

        # Slot 2: Strategy B.
        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
            quantity = math.floor(20000 / aapl_close)

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity, tag="Strategy B buy")
                self.aapl_lot = quantity

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
        self.previous_aapl_rsi = current_aapl_rsi
